LanguageData.BOR_ArchotechBionics.label: archotech bionics
LanguageData.BOR_ArchotechBionics.description: Using the most ground breaking techniques known to both glitterworlds and independent mad scientists, we can now create bionics mimicking the archotech synthetic bodies.
LanguageData.BOR_CPD_Research_FuelRodDeepdrill.label: BOR fuel rod deepdrill
LanguageData.BOR_CPD_Research_FuelRodDeepdrill.descri: Combine the drilling apparatus of the chemfuel-powered deepdrill with a BOR fuel rod generator, yielding a self-powered drill that runs for extraordinary durations on a single fuel rod and outputs 50% more power than its chemfuel predecessor.
LanguageData.BOR_CPD_Research_QuasarNeutroniumDeepdri: Quasar-tier containment and internal power-routing let a deepdrill run directly on neutronium while isolating the output from the colony grid. The upgraded borefield architecture also suppresses infestation formation around drill operations.
LanguageData.BOR_GrandProjectors.label: tenebral holographics
LanguageData.BOR_GrandProjectors.description: Hyper advanced technology enabled by tenebrite allows us to create beautiful and useful holographic projectors and even mount them on Royal thrones.
LanguageData.BOR_LargeProjectors.label: quasar holographics
LanguageData.BOR_LargeProjectors.description: Ultra advanced technology enabled by quasar alloys allows us to create beautiful and useful holographic projectors and even mount them on Royal thrones.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarDesk.label: Quasar Learning Desk
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarDesk.description: Learn to use Quasar PC as learning station.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Core_Drill.label: Planetary Crust Exploitation
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Core_Drill.description: Sunsteel allows us to achieve what most thought impossible up until now. We can invent machines that will extract materials we need from deep beneath the planetary mantle.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Mechtech_I.label: solar mechtech
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Mechtech_I.description: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control basic-tier mechanoids with solar technology.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Mechtech_II.label: quasar mechtech
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Mechtech_II.description: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control basic-tier mechanoids with quasar technology.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Mechtech_III.label: tenebral mechtech
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Mechtech_III.description: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control basic-tier mechanoids with tenebral technology.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_III_Wasteful.label: wasteful tier III refining
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_III_Wasteful.descrip: Devise new refining methods that produce twice as fast but produce a lot of waste.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_II_Wasteful.label: wasteful tier II refining
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_II_Wasteful.descript: Devise new processing methods, producing a lot of waste in exchange for speed.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_I_Wasteful.label: wasteful tier I refining
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_I_Wasteful.descripti: Devise alternative processing methods that are twice as fast, but will in turn produce a lot of waste.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_PollutionPump_I.label: Solar Pollution Pump
LanguageData.BOR_Research_PollutionPump_I.description: Our perfect technologies cannot thrive in imperfect universe. We have to cleanse the mechanoid filth from the soil surrounding us.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_PollutionPump_II.label: Quasar Pollution Pump
LanguageData.BOR_Research_PollutionPump_II.descriptio: Our growing proficiency with the more advanced materials make it easier for us to effectively clean the planet.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_PollutionPump_III.label: Tenebral Pollution Pump
LanguageData.BOR_Research_PollutionPump_III.descripti: With Tenebrite at our disposal cleansing the earth is fast and furiously efficient.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Quasar_FCC.label: quasar fire control tower
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Quasar_FCC.description: Applying the neutronium in the circuits of a fire control station allows us to create computers that can control multiple turrets without a human. It is inferior to Archotech Fire Control but it is autonomous.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Solar_Flare_Shield_I.label: Solar Electromagnetic Shielding
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Solar_Flare_Shield_I.descri: Sunsteel allows us to create machines that would repel a solar flare around our settlements. A pesky star will not be allowed to interfere with progress.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Solar_Flare_Shield_III.desc: Our advancements into the very fabric of universe allow us to intercept the solar particles and turn them to our advantage. While this process produces enormous heat, it will also be a useful spike for our batteries.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Tenebral_FCC.label: Tenebral Fire Control Computer
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Tenebral_FCC.description: Tenebral components allow us to create a fire control computer analogous to the archotech creation, fighting our battles for what.
LanguageData.BOR_SmallProjectors.label: solar holographics
LanguageData.BOR_SmallProjectors.description: Super advanced technology enabled by Sunsteel allows us to create beautiful and useful holographic projectors.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarDesk.label: Solar Learning Desk
LanguageData.BOR_SolarDesk.description: Learn to use Solar PC as learning station.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralDesk.label: Tenebral Learning Desk
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralDesk.description: Learn to use Tenebral PC as learning station.
